en.headline: Janice Vidal and Gigi Yim share Ultimate Song Chart stage on Saturday
en.dek: Commercial Radio 903’s concert She and Her Secret is scheduled for 7 p.m. on 29 August at AsiaWorld-Expo Arena, pairing the two singers on a single billed night.
body: Singers Janice Vidal and Gigi Yim are due to appear together on Saturday at AsiaWorld-Expo Arena in Commercial Radio 903’s Ultimate Song Chart concert She and Her Secret.

The organisers list the start time as 7 p.m. on 29 August. The concert is presented as a joint billing rather than two separate sets, with the station describing the night around a shared programme under that title.

Vidal has a long catalogue of Cantopop recordings; Yim came to wider notice through the television singing contest King Maker and has since released her own singles. The two have previously shared a stage on that programme.
AsiaWorld-Expo is on the Airport Express and city-bus network at Chek Lap Kok. The station has directed listeners to its own channels for the latest door and ticketing notices.

zh.headline: 衛蘭炎明熹周六亞博拉闊音樂會同台
zh.dek: 吆哮903主辦《拉闊音樂會 她和她的秘密》訂於8月29日晚上7時在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行。
body: 歌手衛蘭與炎明熹將於周六在亞洲國際博覽館Arena同台，演出吆哮903主辦的《拉闊音樂會 她和她的秘密》。
主辦單位公布開場時間為8月29日晚上7時。音樂會以兩人聯名演出形式舉行，而非分場獨立公演。
衛蘭長期活躍於粵語流行樂壇；炎明熹因參加電視歌唱比賽為較多人認識，其後推出個人作品。兩人早前已在該比賽節目同台演唱。
亞洲國際博覽館位於赤鰭角，可乘機場快紋及巴士前往。最新入場及售票安排以電台公布為準。
